# Dr. Sheesha Dubai

> Shisha lounge and restaurant in Al Karama, Dubai, UAE — open daily 12 PM to 6 AM.

## About

Dr. Sheesha is a shisha (hookah) lounge, cafe and dine-in restaurant in Al Karama, Dubai, a short drive from Bur Dubai. It serves 40+ sheesha flavours with full lunch, dinner and late-night food until 6 AM. Popular for friends' hangouts, group dinners, birthdays, date nights and weekend nights out. Board games (carrom, chess, Jackaroo) available.

## Menu Highlights

- Sheesha: Mystic Haze, Tropical Delight, Blue Mist, Lady Killer, Double Apple Mint, American Starbuzz and German flavours; live sheesha-making show
- From the clay oven: chicken tikka, paneer tikka, tandoori prawns, Pathani chicken, naan
- Biryani & curries: chicken and mutton biryani, Dhaba butter chicken, mutton rogan josh, dal makhani
- Chaat & small bites: dahi puri, ragda samosa, truffle parmesan fries, mezze platter, falafel
- Asian, pizza & pasta: dragon chicken, chicken lollipop, Hakka noodles, tandoori tadka pizza, pesto pasta, burgers
- Drinks & desserts: mocktails, mojitos, milkshakes, specialty coffee, kadak chai, Moroccan tea, konafa
- Full digital menu: https://qr.mydigimenu.com/c2764751-64d6-4175-9d56-2d3b67d239d4
